system.description: Your fundamental closeness to Caine. You must spend one Background or Free Trait per Generation purchased; characters start at the 13th generation and drop one generation per Trait spent. Lower generation increases your maximum Traits, maximum Abilities, Blood Pool, and Willpower (see the Generation chart), but also makes you a more tempting target for diablerie.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
